modalities.evidence: The histopathological slides were stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), digitized
captured at 20x magnification using a bright-field Olympus microscope equipped with a hyperspectral camera

output.population: 47 patients diagnosed with breast tumors, of whom 22 had distant recurrence during the 10 years of follow-up after diagnosis
output.summary: Histopathological and hyperspectral images of primary breast tumor biopsies with clinical data, annotated by pathologists, labeled for distant recurrence over ten years of follow-up after diagnosis.
